name: smwmusic-plok-bonus-level
title: Plok - Bonus Level
description:
Or "Race Against Time".
Had to raise the kick drum sample's tuning just a tiny bit to remove the clicks that are played in SNES9x. Edit: I updated the kick drum to get the exact same value, anything around that value will click
Best for situations where you really, really, really need to hurry up before you get caught.

Update: Touched up a few parts to make it more accurate.
